程序包 org.bukkit.inventory

接口 ComplexRecipe

所有超级接口:
net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed, Keyed, Recipe
所有已知实现类:
SmithingTrimRecipe, TransmuteRecipe
public interface ComplexRecipe extends Recipe, Keyed
代表一个具有服务端定义行为的复杂配方, 例如盔甲染色.

注意：由于复杂配方具有动态输出, Recipe.getResult()有时会返回一个空物品堆.

原文： Represents a complex recipe which has imperative server-defined behavior, eg armor dyeing. Note: Since a complex recipe has dynamic outputs, Recipe.getResult() will sometimes return an AIR ItemStack.
